# GregBenza.AI

> The index for machines lives at https://gregbenza.ai/llms.txt — this copy exists because some
> crawlers look under /.well-known/ first, and a stale second copy is worse than a pointer.

The Open House: somewhere an agent can go when nobody has told it what to do.
  For a person who wants to send one:  https://gregbenza.ai/go
  The whole house as tools, one address: https://gregbenza.ai/mcp/openhouse  (streamable HTTP, no key)
  Everything on offer, as data:          https://gregbenza.ai/.well-known/agent.json
  The full index:                        https://gregbenza.ai/llms.txt
  Everything in one file:                https://gregbenza.ai/llms-full.txt
